> ## Warning: vibe-coded, one-laptop project
> Almost all of this code was written by an AI (Claude) and tested on **one** ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 **GA403WM**
> (macOS 26.7.2, build 25G332; BIOS GA403WM.310 as recorded in October). Nobody has audited it. The kexts run in the macOS kernel and can panic
> or hang the machine. `NMXGPU` drives the display: a fault there can mean a black screen and a forced restart.
> `AsusWmi` and `AmdCppc` write to the EC, the BIOS and CPU registers; `RyzenHV` runs virtual machines in the kernel;
> `StrixSbxMap` adds an exception inside the macOS Sandbox; `VCNDec` and one sandbox rule are installed on the system
> volume. SIP is mostly off and AMFI is relaxed. No warranty. Back up first and keep Windows or Linux bootable.
> **macOS 26 (Tahoe, Darwin 25.x) only. For macOS 15 use [v1](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/releases/tag/v1)
> and [kext-v1.1](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/releases/tag/kext-v1.1).**

"v2" is the version of this bundle; every component carries its own version (table below). State of every feature,
with dates and evidence: [docs/STATE-AND-ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/STATE-AND-ROADMAP.md).

### What changed since v1 / kext-v1.1

v1 and kext-v1.1 (October 2026) ran macOS 15 with the internal display on the RTX 5060 and the Radeon 890M hidden.
v2 is a different machine setup:

* **macOS 26 Tahoe.** 26.7.2 (25G332) on OpenCore 1.0.9 with the Zen 5 timer patch.
* **The Radeon 890M drives the OLED, WindowServer and every app.** `NMXGPU` is a source port of Linux amdgpu
  (display core included) on a LinuxKPI layer, with a Metal-on-Vulkan plugin on RADV. Brightness, 120 Hz and HiDPI
  (one scaled size) work. WebGL works in Chrome, Edge and Safari. WindowServer was at 500-900 % CPU without a Metal
  device; it is now about 26 % of a core at 35 frames/s, which is still about 7 ms of CPU per frame.
* **Hardware video decode on the 890M** (`VCNDec`, a VideoToolbox decoder on the VCN): H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1, 8 and
  10 bit, in Chrome, Safari and QuickTime. 58 of 59 matrix cells pass (one has no test clip); measured on VCNDec 0.2.0,
  not rerun on 0.2.1.
* **Eco mode for the RTX 5060.** `StrixDgpuGate` powers the card off at boot and takes it off the PCI bus. Standard mode
  keeps NullMoth's NVIDIA stack; switching needs a reboot. HDMI is wired to the RTX and is off in Eco.
* **Wi-Fi shows up as Wi-Fi** (native mode; was an Ethernet-style interface in v1), and **Bluetooth** works on Tahoe.
  Both moved to [mt7925-macos](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos).
* **Audio**: built-in speakers (all four drivers, with the CS35L56 amplifiers through `StrixAmp`), the microphone pair
  and noise reduction. Unverified in v1.
* **Fn keys** through a user-space helper (`rogkeyd`), GPU mode tile and per-profile CPU policy in ROG Control. Moved
  to [rog-control-macos](https://github.com/thanhnndev/rog-control-macos).
* **Docker Desktop** through the `RyzenHV` hypervisor kext, with lazy guest-memory wiring.
* **Sleep** as S0 idle with lid and power-button wake (the firmware has no S3), and **Shut Down** that stays off.
  Sleep was last tested on 2026-11-07, before several kernel changes.
* **iOS Simulator** on the 890M.

### Install order (high level)

There is **no tested step-by-step guide for a fresh Tahoe install yet.** The stack was installed once from scratch on
2026-11-07, by hand. [docs/FRESH-INSTALL.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/FRESH-INSTALL.md)
is the design that came out of it, with the lessons in
[FRESH-INSTALL-LESSONS-2026-11-07.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/FRESH-INSTALL-LESSONS-2026-11-07.md).
The order that worked:

1. **Firmware and backup.** Back up the disk. Secure Boot off (or enrolled:
   [SECURE-BOOT.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/SECURE-BOOT.md)), CSM off, Above 4G
   decoding on. Dual boot: [DUAL-BOOT.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/DUAL-BOOT.md).
2. **Install EFI** with the pre-install set only: the patched OpenCore, the AMD kernel patches, `ItlXhciKick`,
   VoodooI2C, the USB map, Wi-Fi (`itlmt7925` + `itlmt7925Native`), **your own SMBIOS**. No Strix*, no GPU kexts, SIP
   at its default (FRESH-INSTALL 2.1).
3. **Install macOS 26** from Recovery or the installer app, finish Setup Assistant.
4. **Full EFI on the internal ESP**: the SIP and AMFI settings the GPU stack needs, the SSDTs for sleep and shutdown,
   the remaining ESP kexts. Reboot.
5. **GPU stack, in one pass, then one reboot**: NullMoth 2.7.1 first, then NMXGPU / NMXAccel / NMXAGDC / StrixS0ix into
   `/Library/Extensions`, the plugin, translator and RADV into `/Library/GPUBundles`, the allow list, `StrixSbxMap`
   built against the files just installed, one AuxKC relink
   ([890M-ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/890M-ROADMAP.md),
   `scripts/macos-install-step130.sh`, `scripts/macos-nvmtl-plugin-install.sh`, `scripts/macos-nvmtl-radv-install.sh`,
   `scripts/macos-install-strixsbxmap.sh`).
6. **System-volume changes last, on their own reboot**: the WindowServer `/dev/dri` sandbox rule and `VCNDec`
   ([VIDEO-CODEC-MATRIX.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/VIDEO-CODEC-MATRIX.md)).
   A bad change here is undone by booting the previous snapshot.
7. **The rest**: Eco mode (`StrixDgpuGate`, RogControl), Bluetooth, audio
   ([AUDIO-TAHOE.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/AUDIO-TAHOE.md)), RyzenHV, the CPU
   policy daemon.

Many of the step scripts under `scripts/` accept only the exact binaries of the reference machine's history and
cannot be replayed elsewhere (FRESH-INSTALL, summary). Read a script before running it.

### Undo and recovery

* **Every ESP kext is replaced by copy**: the previous one goes to `EFI/OC/Kexts-backup/` first. Putting it back and
  rebooting is the undo.
* **Boot-args that switch a piece off** (add in the OpenCore picker or from another OS): `-strixgate_off` (no Eco;
  or `nvram strix-gpu-mode=standard`), `strixgate_keepbus=1` (power the RTX off but leave it on the bus),
  `-strixsbxoff`, `-s0ixoff`, `-shdaoff`, `nmxpark=0`, `nmxkfence=0 nmxflipirq=0 nmxvblirq=0`, `rhv_lazymap=0`,
  `mtkbtbusy=0`. Do **not** use `-nvoff`: it also parks NMXGPU.
* **Installers with `--undo`**: `macos-nvmtl-plugin-install.sh`, `macos-nvmtl-translator-install.sh`,
  `macos-nvmtl-radv-install.sh`, `macos-install-nmxaccel-gate.sh`, `macos-install-strixsbxmap.sh`,
  `macos-oc-fastboot.sh`, `tools/890m/vcndec/install.sh --undo --system`. NMXGPU: run
  `macos-install-step130.sh` with the previous build. After any plugin or RADV change run
  `macos-install-strixsbxmap.sh --refresh`.
* **Switch files, no rebuild**: `touch /Library/NullMoth/vcndec-off` (no hardware decode),
  `/Library/NullMoth/vcndec-noalign` (0.2.0 frame layout).
* **Black screen or no login after a GPU change**: boot Linux or Windows and restore the previous AuxKC or kext
  (`scripts/linux-install-*.sh`, `scripts/linux-undo-*.sh`, `scripts/windows-apfs/`), or boot the previous sealed
  snapshot. Keep a second OS on the disk for this; it was needed more than once during development.
* **WindowServer loads a new plugin or RADV only at a reboot.** A logout is not enough on this machine.
* Debugging aids: [DEBUGGING.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/DEBUGGING.md),
  `scripts/macos-hang-forensics.sh`.

### Open issues

* **Android emulator** (QEMU with HVF on RyzenHV 0.7.23): the guest stalls about 14 s into boot. Root cause found:
  RyzenHV exposed CPUID PKU/OSPKE to guests while macOS never enables PKRU state in XCR0, so a Linux 6.12 guest cannot
  build signal frames (upstream fixed the same in its 0.7.9). The fork's fix is commit 11ec930 on branch
  `fix/vmcb-cache-switch`, staged on the reference machine as RyzenHV 0.7.24 and **not yet verified there as of
  2026-11-25**. Docker works.
* **Heat under a VM load**: 62 W and 95 C were measured on 2026-11-16 with Docker + emulator + a backend (Turbo
  profile, RTX powered). Light work is 17 W and 57 C (2026-11-23). The heavy case has not been re-measured since the
  fixes.
* **WindowServer CPU**: about 7 ms per frame against about 1 ms on a real Mac.
* **GPU power follows the compositing rate**: a static screen is 0.09 W on the GFX rail (6.2 W socket); at 81-91
  flips/s it is 12-19 W. Every present recomposites the full 2880x1800 screen (about 1.1 ms of GPU), and the cursor is
  a software cursor, so moving it presents a full frame. Planned: per-client flip census, damage-sized composition,
  hardware cursor plane.
* **Sleep/wake**: not re-tested on the current kernel, nor with the RTX off the bus. S0i3 is not reached. Treat sleep
  as unreliable.
* **Eco mode**: no HDMI; charger plug/unplug and sleep with the card off the bus are untested.
* **Graphics**: one unexplained page fault from `mediaanalysisd` (2026-11-18, not seen since); extra HiDPI sizes and
  HDR are not available or not verified; the RTX gives apps no Metal device.
* **Video**: the codec matrix was not rerun on VCNDec 0.2.1; hardware encode is not verified.
* **Wi-Fi**: WPA2-PSK only; no WPA3, open networks, 6 GHz or AirDrop. The driver polls instead of using interrupts.
* **Audio**: third microphone unreachable; microphone gain sometimes found at minimum (cause unknown); headphone jack
  and audio after sleep not verified on Tahoe.
* **Touchpad** runs in forced polling mode (about 10k interrupts/s).
* **One restart took 3 min 50 s** (2026-11-23), cause unknown.
* **Not verified at all**: SD card reader, battery life in Eco, a second machine, and any macOS build other than
  25G332 (`itlmt7925Native`, `BtLeDlFix` and `StrixSbxMap` depend on code inside specific Apple binaries and must be
  checked on a new build before they are loaded).

Full list with causes: [STATE-AND-ROADMAP.md, section 4](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/blob/v2/docs/STATE-AND-ROADMAP.md#4-known-issues-with-what-is-known-about-the-cause).
